hi, i want to know how can i make dashing like in Mother 3 (hold run button for a short period of time then release)
after this, the character starts running by their own (the movement keys are used to change the direction) and only stops when they touch a wall or if the player presses the run button again (also, this mechanic can be used to ram weaker enemies to stun or kill them instantly, in case this is too hard to make, then ignore the last part)
example below (1:07:58):

https://earthbound.fandom.com/wiki/Dash
also, i want to know if i can pay someone if needed

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Probably you can event it too. Parallel common event checks your run button, changes player speed and puts a repeating move route on you player and turns a switch on for another parallel common event that checks your button presses and turns direction and puts a repeating move route on that direction. Then the parallel event can also check that if the tile in front of player is impassable you stop the move route (maybe with animation and jump in place etc). Same if you press the run button again. Also you can make the run event turn on another switch and then have your enemies and events have a player touch page with that switch condition to launch the ram event.
But yeah, maybe someone can make you a plugin too LOL.

it may be coded with a global switchs.
